purpose: Teach: 立国/徘徊/潜む/具現/平衡/肥大/抱負/修業

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、技術立国を目指した政策を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you focused your paper on policies aimed at building a tech-driven nation, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Slight lift on the confirmation tag. Genuinely curious, not testing. The tone of a teacher who's read the work and wants to hear him talk about it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、徘徊する高齢者の見守り体制を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—actually, I wrote about monitoring systems for elderly people who wander.
lines.style: Quiet, almost apologetic correction. Gentle but clear. A pause before the pivot, like he's used to being misread. Not defensive, just precise.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、組織内に潜む差別構造を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote about hidden discrimination within organizations, then?
lines.style: Measured re-calibration. Not accusatory—thoughtful. A soft confirmation-check, respecting his pattern of gentle corrections. Attentive and listening harder now.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、理念を具現する企業の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I actually examined companies that successfully embody their founding principles.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. Another quiet correction, but with slight warmth this time—he's answering what she's genuinely asking. No frustration, just the rhythm of being understood.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 医療における平衡感覚の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: So you looked at balance and proprioception in medical contexts?
lines.style: Engaged but uncertain—a genuine question this time, not an assumption. Open ending, inviting him in. Lighter, more collaborative tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、政治家の権力が肥大する仕組みを論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I focused on how politicians' power tends to expand over time—the mechanisms behind it.
lines.style: Patient but clear. There's a rhythm to this now—he's correcting her again without any edge. Calm, explanatory, like he's learned she'll listen if he just says what's true.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、若い世代の抱負を聞き取った研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You researched young people's hopes and aspirations through interviews, is that right?
lines.style: Lighter touch here—asking more genuinely than asserting. Warm curiosity. A hint that she's starting to follow his actual interests rather than predict them.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、伝統芸能の修業の道のりを論文で扱いました
lines.en: No, actually—I wrote about the long path of training in traditional performing arts.
lines.style: Gentle final correction. Softer somehow, more settled. A small tired smile underneath. He's used to this, but there's acceptance in his tone now, not weariness.
